title: Ultiself app
body: If you are looking for an analytical approach to habit building and want to discover how specific routines physically and mentally affect your day, Ultiself offers a comprehensive, feature-rich platform. However, if you prefer a minimal, free-form daily planner or are sensitive to subscription-based models, a simpler alternative like Habitica or Streaks might be a better fit.

title: Good App - poor interface
body:
Good app which serves an important function, but the unattractive and clunky interface makes it a bore to use. Should be feeling a dopamine hit every time I tick a habit off the list, and have immediately exciting and motivating info regarding my progress. Unfortunately, the app doesn’t give that . Would love to see a serious update

Can we get widget support ?
